title: People and reasons — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. Describe appearance and character. Eftersom introduces a reason. In that subordinate clause, sentence adverbs such as inte precede the finite verb.

s01.sentenceGloss: She stays at home because she is ill.

s02.sentenceGloss: He is tired because he has not slept.

s03.sentenceGloss: She is 190 centimetres tall and very tall.

s04.sentenceGloss: He always helps others and is very kind.

s05.sentenceGloss: She has a husband; she is married.

s06.sentenceGloss: Unfortunately I cannot come to the party.

s07.sentenceGloss: She does not smoke at any time; she never smokes.

s08.sentenceGloss: What does your brother look like?
